description.value: The Shore Kelowna is a luxury all-suite property on Okanagan Lake in the Lower Mission neighbourhood, offering fully furnished studio through three-bedroom suites with in-suite kitchens, private balconies, and shared outdoor spaces. The property sits steps from Gyro Beach and connects to Kelowna's lakeside paths, with the website featuring a dedicated cyclists' guide to the city among its blog content. It also offers vacation-stay options alongside its primary long-term rental offering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active luxury all-suite property at 3499 Lakeshore Road with contact details matching OSM exactly. Suite amenity listings on the /live/ page confirm in-suite washer/dryer, and the website explicitly states dining and restaurants are within walking distance. No bike-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, pump, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content, and the /amenities/ page returned near-empty content likely due to JavaScript rendering.
concerns: Property primarily markets long-term residential rentals (contact form stay options begin at 3-5 months); short-term vacation availability is referenced in site navigation but details were not present in fetched content — cycle tourists should verify short-stay booking before relying on this listing.
The /amenities/ page returned near-empty content, likely JavaScript-rendered, leaving the full amenity list unverifiable from fetched HTML.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating luxury accommodation in a prime Kelowna cycling location with active website and fully confirmed contact details; useful to touring cyclists seeking overnight accommodation near Okanagan Lake routes.
